defect.problem: The page presents an unqualified good-law treatment as of 2026-06-30, but the same disclosed lake record contains unresolved proposed progeny edges marked overruled, abrogated, and questioned. Without the full progeny opinions or an audit resolving those proposed negative edges, the unqualified good_law and varies_by_point=false treatment call cannot be verified under the default-refute rule.
defect.proposed_fix: Audit the proposed negative progeny edges before presenting an unqualified good_law call. Either confirm they are irrelevant/proposed-only and add that caveat, or downgrade/update the treatment status and point overrides as appropriate.

reasons: The content page and payload assert field_i_validity good_law as of 2026-06-30.

The disclosed treatment.edges include proposed entries with field_ii values questioned, overruled, and abrogated, while point_overrides is empty and varies_by_point is false.
residual_risks: The top-level lake judgment also says good_law, so an audit may ultimately preserve the status; the defect is the unqualified presentation despite unresolved disclosed negative-edge data.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Separate confirmed treatment from proposed-edge risk in the rendered treatment note.
